United by one profound purpose: to reach **EVERY PATIENT POSSIBLE**. At Avalere Health, we ensure every patient is identified, treated, supported, and cared for. Equally. Our Advisory, Medical, and Marketing teams come together – powerfully and intentionally – to forge unconventional connections, building a future where healthcare is not a barrier and no patient is left behind.  

Achieving our mission starts with providing enriching, purpose\-driven careers for our team that empower them to make a tangible impact on patient lives. We are committed to creating a culture where our employees are empowered to bring their whole selves to work and tap into the power of diverse backgrounds and skillsets to play a part in making a difference for every patient, everywhere.  

Our flexible approach to working allows our global teams to decide where they want to work, whether in\-office or at home based on team and client need. Major city hubs in London, Manchester, Washington, D.C., and New York, and smaller offices globally, serve as collaboration hubs allowing our teams to come together when it matters. Homeworkers are equally supported, with dedicated social opportunities and resources.  

  

Our inclusive culture is at the heart of everything we do. We proudly support our employees in bringing their whole selves to work with our six Employee Network Groups – Diverse Ability, Family, Gender, LGBTQ\+, Mental Health, and Race/Ethnicity. These groups provide opportunities to promote diversity, equity, and inclusion and to connect, learn, and socialise through regular meetings and programs of activity. We take pride in being part of the Disability Confident Scheme. This helps make sure you can be interviewed fairly if you have a disability, long term health condition, or are neurodiverse. If you'd like to apply and need adjustments made, you can let us know in your application.

* Pharmaceutical experience required
* Launch experience required

**What we can offer**  

You will receive a 401K plan with an employer match contribution up to 4% (immediately vested), as well as life insurance, disability coverage, and medical, dental, and vision plans for peace of mind. Enjoy flexible working arrangements, including hybrid and remote work, along with the option to work from anywhere across the globe two weeks each year. We provide 20 vacation days plus one personal well\-being day, recognise 9 public holidays, along with gifted end\-of\-year holidays and an early Summer Friday finish in June, July, and August.  

Access free counselling through our employee assistance program and personalized health support. Our enhanced maternity, paternity, family leave, and fertility policies provide support across every stage of your family\-planning journey. You can also benefit from continuous opportunities to professionally develop with on\-demand training, support, and global mobility opportunities across the business.

jobs.description:
**Location: NYC (hybrid \- 3x onsite)**
  

**Job Type: 8\-month W2 hourly contract (extension/conversion based on performance)**
  

**Compensation Range: $60\-67/hr**
  

**Benefits: health/vision/dental, 401k, and more (https://shorturl.at/GMPcb)**
  

  

Brand is advancing a multi\-year transformation to build an AI\-enabled, integrated, and agency\-light content operating model. This involves Adobe\-enabled transformation, creative workflow redesign, selective in\-housing of production/post\-production, marketer self\-service, digital asset management (DAM), agency optimization, and value realization.
  

  

We are seeking a strategic, hands\-on transformation leader to turn emerging AI capabilities into practical, governed, and scalable ways of working. Partnering across Brand Creative, Creative Operations, Brand AI Transformation, Finance, Sourcing, Marketing Transformation, Product, Tech, Legal, Risk, and agencies, this role determines which work moves in\-house, stays with agencies, operates hybrid, or becomes marketer self\-service.
  

  

This is not a traditional finance, project coordinator, or tech\-product role. The ideal candidate combines transformation strategy, creative ops, AI fluency, operating\-model design, and commercial discipline to assess ambiguous workflows, establish facts, recommend future\-state models, mobilize stakeholders, and execute roadmaps with measurable business cases.
  

  

**Primary Outcomes**

* Define the future\-state creative and content operating model.
* Identify and prioritize viable in\-housing opportunities (creative, production, post\-production, high\-volume adaptation).
* Translate creative and business needs into clear Adobe and enterprise\-tech requirements.
* Design and execute pilots validating quality, speed, capacity, controls, and economics before scaling.
* Establish an agency\-light model preserving external partners for high\-value strategy, original creative, specialist craft, and variable capacity.
* Build credible value cases connecting workflow changes to agency\-scope and budget decisions.
* Create operating mechanisms to sustain capabilities post\-transformation.

**Responsibilities:**
  

**Transformation strategy and operating\-model design**


* Lead current\-state assessments of creative, production, post\-production, and asset\-management workflows to resolve fragmentation, handoffs, rework, and capacity constraints.
* Design future\-state workflows, roles, decision rights, governance forums, service tiers, and handoffs across internal teams and agencies.
* Recommend work allocation across four delivery models: in\-house, agency, hybrid, and marketer self\-service based on value, complexity, volume, risk, craft, automation potential, and capacity.
* Translate strategy into sequenced roadmaps, implementation requirements, decision points, and measurable outcomes.
* Ensure pilots have a clear path to operationalization, ownership, training, support, and steady\-state delivery.

**Creative operations and in\-housing strategy**


* Assess creative workflows from brief/intake through concept, production, review, approval, delivery, trafficking, and archiving.
* Evaluate opportunities across photography, video, motion graphics, retouching, versioning, resizing, templates, and social content.
* Develop make\-versus\-buy assessments evaluating quality, speed, cost, capacity, risk, expertise, and demand variability.
* Define the talent, skills, capacity, workflow, and technology needed to internalize selected work.
* Establish pilot criteria and scale gates (quality, utilization, turnaround, rework, stakeholder acceptance, unit economics).
* Support the transition of approved work from agencies to internal teams, including scope definition, knowledge transfer, documentation, and readiness.
* Partner with Sourcing and Finance to align in\-housing plans with agency contracts, retainers, and SOWs.

**AI and Adobe capability strategy**


* Translate creative jobs\-to\-be\-done into structured business, workflow, data, governance, and tech requirements.
* Assess where AI can automate or augment work versus where human judgment and specialist craft must remain primary controls.
* Partner with Adobe, Product, and Tech teams to evaluate relevant tools (Creative Cloud, Firefly, Firefly Services, Adobe Express, GenStudio, Frame.io, AEM Assets, Workfront), distinguishing out\-of\-the\-box, configuration, integration, and new\-build needs.
* Design use cases and pilots with explicit inputs, outputs, success criteria, human review points, and handoffs.
* Evaluate AI outputs for strategic fit, quality, brand consistency, repeatability, rights, and control readiness.
* Help establish responsible\-AI practices, including approved boundaries, human review, documentation, transparency, brand governance, and escalation paths.
* Remain technology\-agnostic to avoid forcing workflows into ill\-fitting tools.

**Workflow, data and governance**


* Define intake requirements, standardized briefs, workflow stages, approval paths, exception handling, and SLAs.
* Establish data requirements to measure demand, capacity, cycle time, revision rounds, automation, asset reuse, spend, and value.
* Partner with Workfront and DAM teams to improve asset traceability from request through storage.
* Define requirements for metadata, taxonomy, naming, rights, ownership, approval evidence, and asset retrieval.
* Develop governance models for templates, self\-service, AI\-assisted content, brand validation, and agency use.

* Distinguish total external spend, addressable spend, gross avoidable cost, internal delivery cost, and net realized value.

jobs.title: Account Director - Agency
jobs.description:
**Account Director – Client \& Affiliate Management**

**Position Summary**

The Account Director is responsible for the strategic leadership, growth, and overall performance of assigned client accounts, while also overseeing the affiliate and media partner relationships that support client delivery.

This role serves as a senior point of contact for clients and is accountable for translating client objectives into actionable performance strategies, coordinating internal teams and external partners, monitoring campaign and lead performance, and ensuring commitments related to volume, quality, cost, and service are achieved.

The Account Director operates as both a client advocate and business owner, balancing client expectations with campaign performance, partner capabilities, profitability, and the company’s broader strategic objectives.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Client Relationship \& Account Leadership**

* Serve as the senior day\-to\-day relationship owner for assigned client accounts.
* Build trusted relationships with client stakeholders and develop a strong understanding of their business objectives, enrollment goals, target audiences, performance expectations, and operational requirements.
* Lead regular client meetings, business reviews, campaign performance discussions, and strategic planning sessions.
* Translate client objectives into clear priorities and execution plans for internal teams and external partners.
* Proactively identify performance concerns, emerging risks, and opportunities and provide clients with clear recommendations and solutions.
* Manage client expectations regarding lead volume, quality, cost, pacing, targeting, and campaign performance.
* Ensure client questions, issues, and escalations are addressed promptly and appropriately.
* Maintain a strong understanding of contractual commitments, campaign requirements, pricing, budgets, and service expectations.

**Affiliate \& Partner Management**

* Manage relationships with affiliate, publisher, lead\-generation, and other external media partners supporting assigned accounts.
* Communicate campaign requirements, targeting criteria, lead specifications, compliance expectations, pricing, volume goals, and quality standards to partners.
* Evaluate affiliate performance using metrics including lead volume, acceptance rates, rejection rates, cost per lead, cost per acquisition, lead quality, conversion performance, and return on investment.
* Monitor lead delivery and identify trends related to filtered, rejected, returned, duplicate, or otherwise non\-compliant leads.
* Hold partners accountable for agreed\-upon performance, quality, compliance, and delivery standards.
* Work with affiliates to optimize campaigns, improve lead quality, adjust volume, resolve performance concerns, and identify opportunities to scale.
* Recommend increasing, reducing, pausing, or terminating partner allocations based on performance.
* Develop strong relationships with high\-performing partners and identify opportunities to expand productive affiliate relationships.
* Assist with sourcing, evaluating, and onboarding new affiliate and media partners where appropriate.

**Revenue \& Account Growth**

* Own the health, retention, and growth of assigned accounts.
* Identify opportunities to expand existing client relationships through increased volume, additional programs, new campaigns, services, products, or media channels.
* Partner with leadership and Business Development on account expansion opportunities.
* Understand account economics, including revenue, partner costs, pricing, gross margin, and profitability.
* Monitor account and partner performance to ensure delivery models remain financially sustainable.
* Participate in forecasting client revenue, campaign volume, and partner allocations.
* Support renewals, pricing discussions, scope changes, and contract extensions as appropriate.

**Cross\-Functional Leadership**

* Serve as the central point of coordination across Client Success, Media, Operations, Analytics, Creative, Product, and other teams supporting assigned accounts.
* Establish clear priorities, responsibilities, timelines, and expectations for account\-related initiatives.
* Ensure internal teams have the information necessary to execute client requirements effectively.
* Facilitate resolution of issues that cross functional or organizational boundaries.
* Escalate material client, partner, financial, compliance, or performance risks to leadership when appropriate.
* Provide clear and timely communication regarding account performance, changes in client priorities, and emerging risks.

**Compliance \& Lead Quality**

* Ensure affiliates and media partners comply with client requirements, company standards, applicable advertising requirements, and campaign\-specific restrictions.
* Partner with internal Compliance, Operations, and Technology teams to investigate lead\-quality or compliance concerns.
* Monitor patterns in rejected, filtered, returned, or disputed leads and work with appropriate teams to determine root causes.
* Ensure partner remediation plans are established when quality or compliance issues are identified.
* Maintain appropriate documentation of significant client and partner performance issues and agreed\-upon corrective actions.

**Performance Measures**

Success in the role may be measured by:

* Client retention and satisfaction
* Account revenue growth
* Gross margin and account profitability
* Achievement of client volume and pacing objectives
* Lead acceptance and delivery rates
* Lead quality and downstream conversion performance
* Cost per lead / cost per acquisition
* Affiliate performance and partner optimization
* Resolution of client and partner issues
* Forecast accuracy
* Identification and execution of account expansion opportunities
* Compliance with client and company requirements

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related

**Company Overview**
Rex is a privately held ecosystem of entrepreneurial ventures led by Peter Rex, spanning real estate private equity, technology, insurance, and AI. We build businesses and investment platforms that generate both exceptional financial returns and meaningful societal impact. At the core of our strategy is investor engagement: attracting aligned capital partners who share our long\-term vision. We are building the most compelling investor\-facing ecosystem in the private markets. The role offers exposure to a uniquely diverse platform, combining institutional\-quality real estate and high\-growth tech ventures, all aligned under a singular mission\-driven vision.  

  

**About Us**
Our mission is to catalyze human flourishing through stewardship, serving people in all nations. We seek a transcendent impact, second to none, crossing geographies and making a permanent mark on history.
We aim to uplift investors, foster flourishing families, create enduring trust, and contribute to a more beautiful world through our investments, products and services, and new ventures.
Our investments are primarily in real estate, with additional allocations to tech, energy, and alternatives, employing a downside\-protected, long\-term approach to investing. We are grounded in timeless morals and seek to preserve and grow both investor capital and our own.
We serve a diverse ecosystem that includes:  

  

* Multifamily apartment management with 20,000\+ apartments
* Hotel and office buildings
* Tech ventures
* Insurance companies
  

  

Our businesses, with over 500 employees, are primarily throughout Texas and Florida, but we aim to expand globally with our products and services, impacting people in all countries.

* Fanatical Investor Focus: Serve our investors by preserving their wealth first and foremost and secondarily seeking to maximize their return on equity while fostering human progress through stewardship of the assets and companies.

* Missionary Zeal: Care about investor stewardship and advancing the vision of catalyzing human flourishing.

Rex is seeking a Content Director, Rex Media to take ownership of our entire media presence and turn it into a growth engine for the business, not just a content calendar. Keep every platform cranking, including LinkedIn, X, Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, and YouTube and YouTube Shorts, using external execution partners where it creates leverage, such as engagement, commenting, and production support, while retaining full ownership of strategy and quality. The ideal candidate has 7 to 12 years of deep, hands\-on experience in content creation and social media, with a demonstrated command of the platform game and a track record that speaks for itself. They have real proficiency in business, finance, and investment concepts, enough to know where to cut a video, which themes will land, and how to speak credibly to a sophisticated audience. They know how to create content that lures attention while still delivering genuine value to a UHNW investor audience, balancing virality with substance. Like all Rex players, they are proactive and resourceful, take the initiative without waiting to be told, and treat obstacles as something to solve rather than escalate. Must be missionary minded, driven to further human flourishing primarily through the stewardship of investor capital and secondarily through how that capital is put to work across real estate, tech, and beyond. Not for mercenaries. Only for missionaries. Fully remote.  

  

#### **About the Role**


Rex is hiring a Content Director, Rex Media to run the company's entire media presence as a business function with a P\&L mindset, not a creative side project. This role owns outcomes, not just output: growth in following and engagement matters, but only insofar as it converts into real investor and customer pipeline.

Every other format, written, short\-form, platform\-native, exists downstream of a high\-quality video production engine, and you will own that pipeline from concept through distribution. You will build and manage a full\-funnel content strategy, engineering the specific mechanisms that move someone from a first view to a qualified investor or customer conversation, and reporting on that path with the same rigor Rex applies to capital.

jobs.description:
We're looking for an experienced and driven Integrated Marketing Manager to lead the go\-to\-market plan and programs for NMI's payment gateway, with a focus on generating pipeline, acquiring new ISO partners and increasing adoption across priority vertical markets.



In this role, you'll develop and execute integrated marketing strategies that bring together demand generation, content, digital, channel, sales and product marketing. A key part of the role will also be developing a verticalized marketing approach for markets such as parking, transit, EV charging and healthcare, making NMI's gateway proposition more relevant to the specific needs, use cases and audiences within each market.



ISOs will be the primary audience, alongside vertical specific ISVs and software providers.



This is both a strategic and hands on role. You'll identify where the biggest opportunities lie, build the marketing strategy and work across teams to turn it into campaigns that deliver measurable pipeline and revenue impact.


### **About NMI**



NMI, a global leader in payment technologies, allows software and sales professionals to deliver payment innovations to their clients without having to build payment expertise in house. NMI enables our partners with choice, and challenges the one\-size\-fits\-all approach to payments. You've probably used NMI in the last 24 hours without even realizing it. We're the platform that powers success for innovative tech created by SMBs, entrepreneurs and fintech startups. We're creative problem solvers who help visionaries smash through boundaries and think beyond what's possible so they can think about what's next. But we're not just built for the tech savvy. We democratize the latest payments technology so that everyone can realize the benefits of easy payments across the full spectrum of commerce. Our mission is to use our expertise to enable more payments, in more ways and more places. We provide ISOs, Fintech Innovators and Technologists the freedom to focus on what they do best, liberating them from restricted payment solutions and giving them access to the latest payment technology now and in the future.

  


### **How We Work \- Our Core Values**


* **Be a Good Person, It's Simple.** We treat everyone fairly and with respect. We lead with kindness, humility and integrity. We take the time to understand each other and our customers. And we serve with care, because customers are never a transaction, and always our focus
* **Align, Trust \& Go.** We debate openly, listen carefully and challenge thoughtfully. Once we decide, we move forward together \- holding ourselves accountable to our commitments, and focusing on what matters most to our customers. That alignment creates momentum.
* **Raise the Bar.** Good enough isn't enough. We stay curious, measure everything, stay honest about progress and keep pushing ourselves to think creatively. We drive change, again and again. And leave things better than we found them. When we raise the bar, our customers feel it too.

  


### **About the Team**



The NMI marketing team is a group of smart, collaborative people in a fast moving environment. Self\-starters who love solving problems, learning continuously and building creative, data driven campaigns will thrive here.

  


### **Key Responsibilities:**


* Own the integrated marketing strategy and plan for NMI's core payment gateway, aligned to pipeline and revenue goals.
* Develop and execute multi\-channel campaigns to acquire new ISO partners, drive gateway adoption and support cross\-sell and upsell opportunities.
* Develop verticalized marketing strategies for priority markets, using market, customer and competitive insight to tailor positioning, messaging and campaigns to specific industry needs.
* Build a strong understanding of ISO and ISV audiences, their buying journeys, challenges and decision drivers.
* Partner with product marketing and content teams to develop compelling messaging, thought leadership, customer stories, campaign content and sales enablement.
* Work closely with demand generation to define target audiences, campaign journeys, lead follow\-up and conversion strategies.
* Collaborate with sales, channel and other marketing teams to ensure programs are aligned to commercial priorities and effectively executed.
* Manage campaigns from planning through execution, reporting and optimization, ensuring activity stays on track, on budget and on brand.
* Track performance against agreed KPIs and use insights to continuously improve targeting, messaging, channel mix and campaign effectiveness.

### **Essential Skills and Experience:**


* 5\-7\+ years of B2B marketing experience, ideally in payments, fintech, SaaS, or enterprise technology.
* A marketing or related business degree or equivalent.
* Proven experience developing and executing integrated marketing strategies and campaigns that contribute to pipeline and revenue growth.
* Experience with verticalized marketing, including developing market\-specific positioning, messaging and go\-to\-market programs.
* Strong understanding of B2B partner or channel\-led business models. Experience marketing to ISOs, ISVs, PayFacs or other payments audiences is highly desirable.
* Experience working closely with sales and demand generation teams on lead management, account targeting, sales enablement and pipeline acceleration.
* Experience collaborating with and managing agency partners.
* Strong digital marketing, campaign management and performance measurement skills, including marketing automation (Salesforce, Hubspot, Pardot, ZoomInfo), SEM, SEO, PPC, display, programmatic, etc, as well as analytics (GA4\).
* Exceptional project management, communication and stakeholder alignment skills.
* Creativity, curiosity, initiative and a strong commercial mindset.

jobs.title: Creative Services Manager
jobs.description:
Hometown Soccer Holdings (HSH) is building locally rooted MLS NEXT Pro clubs, deeply connected to their communities and poised for long\-term success. Across a growing portfolio, every campaign, matchday, product drop, and announcement generates daily creative demand that outside agencies are poorly suited to serve efficiently. The Creative Services Manager will bring high\-volume creative production in\-house, owning the assets, template systems, and creative workflow that keep every club on brand and moving quickly.  


Reporting to the Vice President of Marketing, this role will produce the social, paid, email, merchandise, matchday, and presentation creative that HSH and its clubs need day to day, and will build the campaign and club launch template systems local teams can populate themselves. The Creative Services Manager will own creative request intake, prioritization, and service levels across clubs and central functions, and will coordinate agencies and freelancers for overflow and specialized work.  


This is a builder's opportunity for a fast, versatile designer who thinks in systems rather than one\-off files. The ideal candidate brings a strong multi\-channel portfolio, demonstrated experience building template systems that other people actually used, and the discipline to work at volume without losing brand craft.  

**Responsibilities:** **Creative Production**  

* Own high\-volume day\-to\-day creative production across all clubs and central functions
* Produce social graphics, paid media assets, email and website graphics, matchday and promotional creative
* Support merchandise graphics and product storytelling assets
* Build presentation decks and sponsorship mockups in support of Sponsorship and Ticket Sales needs
* Support club launch materials across every market ahead of the 2027 season

 **Template \& Asset Systems**  

* Build campaign and club launch template systems local teams can populate themselves
* Maintain the asset library, naming conventions, and version control so assets are findable and current
* Execute and uphold brand guidelines across all daily creative output
* Keep club creative visually consistent with the portfolio brand without flattening local identity
* Reduce agency dependency for recurring production work and document what stays in\-house versus what goes out

 **Creative Workflow \& Request Management**  

* Own creative request intake, prioritization, and published service levels across clubs and central functions
* Maintain a production calendar visible to clubs and central stakeholders
* Coordinate agencies and freelancers for overflow and specialized work, including briefing and quality control
* Escalate capacity conflicts with options
* Feed performance learnings from Performance \& Lifecycle Marketing back into creative direction

 **Club Enablement \& Local Partnership**  

* Turn local asset requests around within published service levels
* Train local content contributors on template use, brand guardrails, and asset standards
* Capture market\-specific inputs and content from clubs and route them into the asset library
* Support local content capture standards in partnership with Fan Engagement and Communications
* Own the creative segment of the recurring central/local operating cadence
* Additional duties as assigned.

  

**Qualifications**

jobs.title: In-Account Business Development Director (Account Director)
jobs.description:
**About Phase2**  

Our remote first employees join and stay at Phase2 to be a force. In pursuit of digital experience that advances the human experience, you will do your best work, live fully, and succeed as a team.  

Phase2 a digital agency passionate about customer experience, grounded in data \& insights, and rooted in more than two decades of successful technology delivery. We guide industry\-leading companies to what’s next in their digital landscape.  

And it all begins with finding the right people who align with our values and passion for impact. **About the Role**
We’re hiring an Account Director to drive consultative growth across a portfolio of clients, leading enterprise\-scale digital and AI\-enabled transformation initiatives.

  

At Phase2, we create custom digital products to solve complex business problems, partnering with clients to build tailored solutions rather than selling SaaS or subscription\-based software.

  

This is a quota\-carrying, in\-account growth role for someone who thrives in a fast\-paced environment, leads with insight, and diagnoses business problems before prescribing solutions.

  

You’ll challenge assumptions, navigate objections, and build business cases that unlock meaningful investment.

  

This role demands a consultative selling and strategic mindset. Success requires the ability to sell vision, outcomes, and transformation, often before clients fully understand what they need.

  

You will operate at the intersection of digital experience, technology modernization, and transformative AI, helping clients move from fragmented initiatives to integrated, high\-impact solutions.

  

* This position reports to the SVP, Account Management

* Commission: $25,000–$50,000 annually at 100% of quota; uncapped commission potential

* Thrive in a fast\-paced environment where solutions must be shaped in real time.
* Ask sharp questions, uncover root problems, and reframe client thinking.
* Are comfortable pushing back, handling objections, and navigating complexity.
* Can translate digital and AI capabilities into the business outcomes that executives care about.
* Know how to sell services, platforms, and transformation.

* Generate a robust pipeline that leads to closing $5M\+ in new revenue within 12 months across an existing portfolio and newly signed clients.

* Shape deal strategy, pricing, and scope for high\-value digital and AI engagements.
* Navigate objections, procurement hurdles, and ambiguity with confidence.

**Sell Digital \& AI Solutions**

* Translate AI and digital capabilities into measurable business impact using value\-selling methodologies.
* A thought leader who guides clients through practical and transformative AI integration across marketing, content, IT, and digital operations.
* Position AI, digital experience, and modernization as business imperatives.
* Build compelling value narratives tied to ROI, risk reduction, speed, and competitive advantage.
* Translate complex technology concepts into clear executive\-level business cases.

**Act as a Trusted Client Advisor**

* Build deep relationships with Senior and C\-Suite stakeholders within accounts.
* Serve as a point of escalation, balancing client needs with internal delivery realities.
* Partner closely with delivery, strategy, and leadership teams to ensure successful outcomes.
* Represent Phase2 at industry events and maintain an active, credible thought leadership presence.
* Travel to client sites, internal offices, or industry events as needed (typically up to 20%).

**Other Ways You’ll Make an Impact**

* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to shape and deliver solutions that drive measurable value.
* Champion client successes internally by ensuring visibility across teams and leadership.
* Support marketing in developing case studies and thought leadership, highlighting client impact.
* Maintain strong leadership presence within accounts by positioning forward\-looking, strategic work that aligns with where the market is headed.
* Collaborate with platform and technology partners to identify and pursue co\-selling opportunities.
* Contribute to a culture of performance, knowledge\-sharing, and sales excellence.

 **What You'll Need*** 10\+ years of consultative digital sales experience within an agency, consultancy, or transformation\-led firm, with a strong track record of growing existing client relationships
* Success in overseeing client portfolios contributing $5 million\+ in revenue annually.
* Ability to generate $5M\+ in sales, including expansions and renewals, within the assigned portfolio within 12 months.
* Strong understanding of digital experience, platforms, and AI\-enabled solutions.
* Comfort operating in ambiguity and shaping solutions collaboratively with clients.
* Experience influencing senior executives through strategic insight, persuasive communication, and effective negotiation.

**What Will Immediately Set You Apart**

* Experience navigating legacy systems, organizational resistance, and competing priorities.
* Ability to clearly generate buyer demand and articulate why clients need to act now.
* Demonstrated use of AI in your own workflow and client conversations.

**What Would Be Nice to Have**

* Experience in regulated industries (e.g., healthcare, pharma, wellness, financial services).
* Familiarity with platforms like Drupal, Acquia, Adobe E

jobs.title: Freelance Creative Marketing Translators & Transcreators | Spanish (Puerto Rico)
jobs.description:
Creative Marketing Translators \& Transcreators \| Spanish (Puerto Rico)
Acclaro is currently recruiting up to **2 Creative Marketing Translators \& Transcreators** **(English \> Spanish (Puerto Rico))** to support ongoing marketing, entertainment, and multimedia localization projects for an active global client.


This remote freelance opportunity is open to experienced linguists who have an exceptional command of **Spanish as used in Puerto Rico** and the creativity to adapt marketing, entertainment, and multimedia content for Puerto Rican audiences.


You will help global brands deliver engaging, culturally relevant content while preserving their voice, creative intent, and marketing impact.


Position Overview* **Language Pair:** English to Spanish for Puerto Rico
* **Domain:** Marketing, Entertainment, and Creative Content
* **Experience:** 3\+ years of translation and creative transcreation experience
* **Contract Type:** Freelance / Independent Contractor
* **Engagement Type:** Project\-Based with Ongoing Opportunities
* **Location:** Remote
* **Compensation:** This is a paid freelance opportunity. Compensation will be determined based on the candidate's proposed rates and project requirements.


Responsibilities* Translate and creatively adapt **marketing, entertainment and multimedia content** to engage and resonate with local audiences.
* Work collaboratively with internal and linguistic teams to ensure high quality output across various platforms.
* Conduct research to understand cultural nuances, ensuring that translations are not just literal but culturally relevant.
* Review and provide feedback on marketing projects to contribute to their success.

  

**Requirements**  

* Native\-level proficiency in **Spanish for Puerto Rico** and a strong understanding of Puerto Rican culture, consumer behavior, and marketing communication styles.
* Proven experience of **3 or more years in translation and transcreation**, preferably in a marketing context.
* Bachelor's degree in **Translation, Marketing, Linguistics, or a related field**.
* Strong understanding of marketing principles and the ability to adapt tone and style to fit various brand guidelines; experience with entertainment or global brand content is a plus.
* Experience translating or transcreating multimedia entertainment content, including TV series and movie synopses, title localization, PR, and other creative content related to TV and movie entertainment, is a plus.
* Experience with CAT tools is a plus.


Application Process
The selection process consists of the following stages:

* **Application review**
* **One\-way video interview**, taking approximately **15 to 20 minutes**, which candidates can complete at a convenient time within the specified deadline
* **Translation and transcreation assessment** to evaluate the linguistic, creative, and cultural skills required for the project
* **Secure identity verification** for candidates selected for the project
* **Onboarding to Acclaro’s systems,** followed by **project\-specific training and onboarding**




Successful completion of each stage is required to be considered for a freelance engagement. All personal information is handled securely for recruitment, contracting, and compliance purposes.

 **Benefits**  

* **Flexible Remote Work:** Work from anywhere, managing your own hours around project deadlines.
* **Long\-Term Collaboration Opportunities:** We aim to build lasting partnerships with our freelance linguists; successful candidates will become part of our preferred talent pool for ongoing, periodic project assignments.
* **Cutting\-Edge Tech:** Gain experience working with advanced localization workflows, AI\-driven translation tools, and global brand content.
* **Elite Projects:** Build your portfolio by working on software utilized by millions of global users daily.


About Acclaro
Acclaro combines cultural and language expertise with AI technology to help brands grow their global presence, connect with customers, and mean something to them. As a trusted partner to some of the world’s biggest brands and fastest\-growing global companies, our mission is to harness the powerful combination of human expertise and cutting\-edge technology. We focus on putting brands into the heads, hearts, and hands of people everywhere.


Our AI\-powered business management and language platform ensures a faster time to market with measurable results, while our global team of language, country, and technology experts crafts localization strategies that empower our customers to succeed in any market.

jobs.title: Brand Manager
jobs.description:
**Job Overview**

We are seeking a dynamic and strategic Brand Manager to lead the development and execution of brand initiatives that elevate our market presence and resonate with our target audiences. In this role, you will craft compelling brand stories, oversee marketing campaigns, and collaborate cross\-functionally to ensure consistent brand messaging. Your energetic approach and analytical mindset will drive brand growth, foster customer loyalty, and position our company as a leader in the industry. This paid position offers an exciting opportunity to shape brand strategy and make a tangible impact on our business success.

**Duties**

* Develop comprehensive brand strategies aligned with company goals, including positioning, messaging, and visual identity.
* Lead the planning and execution of marketing campaigns across multiple channels, ensuring cohesive brand communication.
* Conduct market analysis to identify trends, customer insights, and competitive positioning to inform strategic decisions.
* Manage project timelines, budgets, and resources efficiently using project management tools to meet campaign objectives.
* Collaborate with sales, product development, and creative teams to create engaging content for presentations, reports, and promotional materials using Microsoft PowerPoint and Office tools.
* Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) to evaluate campaign effectiveness and adjust strategies accordingly.
* Foster strong relationships with external partners and stakeholders in B2B marketing environments to expand brand reach.

**Requirements**

* Fluency in English with excellent communication skills for clear articulation of brand messages.
* Proven experience in marketing or brand management with a focus on B2B (business\-to\-business) markets.
* Strong project management skills with the ability to prioritize tasks effectively within tight deadlines.
* Proficiency in analysis skills to interpret market data and consumer insights for strategic planning.
* Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Excel for data analysis and reporting; proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite including Word and Outlook.
* Skilled in creating compelling presentations using Microsoft PowerPoint for internal briefings and external pitches.
* Leadership qualities with the ability to motivate teams and influence stakeholders at all levels.
* Familiarity with IT systems relevant to marketing analytics and digital platforms.
* Excellent organizational skills with keen attention to detail and time management abilities.

Join us as a Brand Manager if you're passionate about building impactful brands through innovative strategies, analytical insights, and energetic leadership!

Pay: £27,966\.10\-£57,704\.33 per year

Benefits:

* Company events
* Flexitime
* Housing allowance
* Work from home

Work Location: Remote
